title: Two distinct projection pathways converge onto the same BLA neurons to contribute to fear memory retrieval
title_zh: 两条不同投射通路汇聚至同一BLA神经元，促进恐惧记忆检索
abstract: Studying the neural circuits that mediate context-induced fear memory retrieval is of importance to develop new therapeutic approaches to prevent post-traumatic stress disorder relapse. The basolateral amygdala (BLA) is crucial for context-induced retrieval of fear memory. Previous studies indicate that projection neurons from the ventral hippocampus CA1 (vCA1) to the BLA (vCA1-BLA neurons) mediate context-induced retrieval of fear memory. However, it remains unclear whether other projection neurons to the BLA are involved in context-induced retrieval of fear memory and how they interact with vCA1-BLA neurons. Our findings indicate that the postrhinal cortex (POR) to the BLA (POR-BLA) neurons are also involved in context-induced retrieval of fear memory. These neurons innervate the same BLA neurons as vCA1-BLA neurons and participate in fear memory retrieval. These results suggest that two different projection neurons of POR-BLA and vCA1-BLA innervate on the same BLA neurons and POR-BLA neurons and vCA1-BLA neuron contribute to fear memory retrieval. These findings provide new insights into the neural mechanisms underlying fear memory retrieval.
abstract_zh: 研究介导情境诱发恐惧记忆检索的神经回路对于开发预防创伤后应激障碍复发的新疗法具有重要意义。基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）在情境诱发的恐惧记忆检索中起关键作用。先前研究表明，腹侧海马CA1（vCA1）向BLA的投射神经元（vCA1-BLA神经元）介导情境诱发的恐惧记忆检索。然而，尚不清楚是否还有其他投射神经元参与情境诱发的恐惧记忆检索，以及它们如何与vCA1-BLA神经元相互作用。我们的发现表明，后顶叶皮层（POR）向BLA的投射神经元（POR-BLA神经元）也参与情境诱发的恐惧记忆检索。这些神经元与vCA1-BLA神经元共同支配同一组BLA神经元，并参与恐惧记忆检索。结果提示，POR-BLA和vCA1-BLA两类投射神经元共同作用于同一BLA神经元，且POR-BLA与vCA1-BLA神经元共同促进恐惧记忆检索。这些发现为阐明恐惧记忆检索的神经机制提供了新的视角。
